items.new_information: 创始人奖励、ECC 离职与 Orchard 四年漏洞并列的看空论述

evidence.quote: Zcash’s latest rally is a narrative bid. A big market cap does not mean a coin earned its place. Sitting near Solana and Hyperliquid on a ranking list does not mean Zcash does what those two do.

The launch was not fair. For the first four years, 20 percent of every block reward was taken as the Founders’ Reward. That money went to founders, staff, advisors, and early investors. It added up to 2.1 million ZEC, or 10 percent of the 21 million cap. Bitcoin paid miners. Zcash also paid a company and its backers. When that first cut was supposed to stop,

The cut did not buy a real economy. Privacy was the sales pitch. Using it was optional. Open addresses stayed the easy path for exchanges and simple wallets. For most of Zcash’s life, most coins sat in the open. Optional privacy is marketing. Default privacy is the protocol. Management stayed a board fight: Electric Coin Company, the Foundation, Bootstrap,

the brand name, the wallet, and who gets the cut. In January 2026 the whole ECC team left and said they were pushed out. That is not a side issue. That is how the project runs. A base-layer team that cannot stay in the same building as its nonprofit board is not “decentralized.” It is broken at the top.

Then came the security mess the market is already trying to skip. In May 2026 a serious bug in the Orchard pool was made public. It had been there about four years. In theory it could create fake ZEC with no clear on-chain trail. Because the pool is private, nobody can prove fake coins were never made. Ironwood in July closed the old pool and forced coins
F2Pool联合创始人王纯（Chun）发文称，Zcash近期反弹并不代表其真正赢得市场，市值排名接近Solana和Hyperliquid，也不意味着Zcash具备同等竞争力。
王纯批评Zcash早期将20%的区块奖励分配给创始人、员工、顾问和投资者，累计约210万枚ZEC；同时，项目隐私功能长期缺乏实际使用，且曾出现持续数年的资金池漏洞。
他认为，Zcash的问题并非单一事件，而是分配机制、治理争议和安全事件长期叠加的结果。
在他看来，Zcash 的基本面配不上目前的前十市值：
-Electric Coin Company (ECC)、基金会与董事会长期宫斗，今年 1 月核心开发团队甚至集体离职，直言是被“赶走的”。
-今年 5 月曝光的 Orchard 隐私池漏洞，更是被市场选择性遗忘。
这个存在了 4 年的严重漏洞，理论上可以无痕迹地凭空增发假币。对于一个标榜自身是“硬通货”的隐私资产来说，私人供应量无法像比特币那样被公开核查，还要靠事后紧急打补丁，这在逻辑上是极其荒谬的。

Six years later, this is still one of the best decisions I have made.

items.summary: 数学家 Buckmaster 指控 OpenAI 在获知其研究路线后由内部模型抢出约 100 页 Navier–Stokes 证明，并两次要求移除在 Anthropic 任职的合作者署名；Bubeck 称指控虚假，证明未公开验证。

items.event: OpenAI 与数学家 Navier–Stokes 抢跑争议
items.new_information: Buckmaster 公开声明的通话细节、署名要求与 Bubeck 的公开否认

evidence.quote: 纽约大学数学家 Tristan Buckmaster 今天发表公开声明，披露了两件事：一是他和合作者借助大语言模型在一个月内攻破了流体力学领域多个重要难题，二是他指控 OpenAI 在得知他的进展后试图抢先发布成果，并要求将他的合作者从署名中移除，理由是对方在 Anthropic 工作。
通话中，Buckmaster 被告知 OpenAI 的一个内部模型已经生成了一份大约 100 页的受迫 Navier-Stokes 方程有限时间爆破证明。Buckmaster 注意到，OpenAI 的技术路线与他和 Alpöge 秘密采用的路线高度重合，而这条路线几乎没有其他人在走。
Buckmaster 追问 OpenAI 是何时开始处理这个问题的。这个问题没有被直接回答，但最终双方确认：第一个提示词是在过去几天内发出的，也就是在 Buckmaster 的工作信息传到 OpenAI 之后。

随后 OpenAI 提出了两个方案：一是 Buckmaster 先发 Euler 结果，OpenAI 第二天发 Navier-Stokes 结果；二是 Buckmaster 独自撰写一篇论文发布 Navier-Stokes 成果，注明系 OpenAI 内部模型所得。Bubeck 两次明确要求将 Alpöge 从署名中移除，说如果不是因为 Alpöge 在 Anthropic 工作，一切会简单得多，还说他在 Anthropic 工作"太烦人了"。OpenAI 还表示，如果他们在 Buckmaster 之后发表，会公开说 Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 配得上 Clay 奖金，称他们是"最接近这个问题的人类"。
Buckmaster 在声明末尾明确划了线：他没有看过 OpenAI 的证明，不知道 OpenAI 的模型做了什么或怎么做的，不知道他们的数据是否被使用，也没有指控任何人任何事。他说自己只是在陈述被告知了什么、何时被告知、以及被提议了什么。他这样做是因为"另一种选择是让一连串公告讲述他知道并非事实的故事"。
OpenAI 的内部模型已经生成了一份大约 100 页的证明，声称可以证明 forced Navier–Stokes 出现 finite-time blow-up。
按照 Buckmaster 的说法，OpenAI 最终告诉他，第一次相关 prompt 是最近几天才发出的。
Buckmaster 指控 Sébastien Bubeck 两次提出把 Alpöge 排除在作者之外，其中一个理由就是 Alpöge 在 Anthropic 工作。
Bubeck 已经公开否认这些指控，称 Buckmaster 的说法「false and inflammatory」。
那份约 100 页的证明还没有公开，没有经过独立验证。

evidence.quote: @phantom: If you created the wallet with Google or Apple, you restore it by signing in with that same account and the 4-digit PIN you set. If you exported the 12-word recovery phrase, you can import those words instead. Saving the Phantom app to iCloud or Google Drive does not restore the wallet.
@solflare: You restore with the recovery phrase you wrote down when you created the wallet. Solflare does not keep a copy, so that phrase is the only way back in.
@Backpack: You restore with the seed phrase. If the device is gone and you don't have those words, Backpack cannot restore the wallet.

@JupiterExchange: If you created a seed wallet, you restore with the 12 or 24 words. If you signed in with social login, the app does not show a recovery phrase. You export the private key from the Jupiter website while you still have access, then import that key on the new phone.

@MetaMask: If you created the wallet with a recovery phrase, you import those words on the new phone. If you created it by signing in with Google, Apple, or Telegram, you sign in with that same account and the MetaMask password you chose.

@TrustWallet: A normal Trust wallet restores with the 12-word recovery phrase. SWIFT is a separate setup inside the same app. It does not use 12 words. It saves a passkey to iCloud Keychain on iPhone, or to Google Password Manager on Android. On a new phone, sign into that same Apple or Google account, add an existing wallet, and pick SWIFT.

evidence.quote: The transfer agent rule hasn't been updated since the 1970s.. Hester Peirce just dropped a 470 page proposal to change that.
The SEC now treats blockchains as electronic record keeping and communications technology.
That's not a crypto carve out, it's an upgrade to the financial system itself.
Stock tokens aren't equities. They're equity linked notes. No shareholder rights. No voting. Just linked to the price, which means self custody. No brokerage required.
The broker dealer paradigm breaks the second you can be your own custodian. You still need a transfer agent.
That's exactly what the SEC just proposed modernizing.

The transfer agent rule proposal, more than a decade in the making, is finally out.  We welcome comment on all aspects, including implications for tokenization: https://t.co/KyOF5WDStE and https://t.co/WAWDuncy4H
Rob (@robbieklages) says the broker-dealer paradigm is broken and unpacks how tokenized stocks let people hold and trade shares without brokers, gutting most of the old system:

"When you hold an equity, you need a brokerage, because you need someone to custody it for you. But in tokenized form, on a stock token, you have the opportunity for self-custody. Which means the broker-dealer paradigm is broken, you can be your own broker-dealer, your own custodian."
"There can be decentralized, distributed brokers, and the existing model for securities no longer applies the same way."

"But you still need a transfer agent to move securities between custodians. That's the real unlock: modernize the transfer-agent framework, and you can unravel a lot of the existing broker-dealer model."

evidence.quote: There's a new data delivery race that's coming with Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade and it's headliner EIP-7732, known as ePBS. It shifts deadlines within a slot and changes the path that block data travels, creating new areas where low latency matters most.

Under ePBS the slot looks completely different. Notably, relays are out of the mix and bids get sent straight from builders to the proposer. The proposer chooses a winning bid, and they'll have that bid selected immediately at the start of the slot. Once the slot begins, the proposer sends out the new beacon block to the rest of the network for attestation.
The deadline for attestation under ePBS is at the 3 second mark of the slot, 1 second earlier than today.

However, the contents of that beacon block won't look the same as today either. Under ePBS the beacon block no longer contains the execution payload (the actual transactions being made), instead it contains a signed header identifying that payload. Proposer duties look relatively similar, except bid selection will occurring earlier, there's slightly less

This portion of the slot is where the winning builder must broadcast the execution payload to the whole validator network. Among the network, 512 validators are selected to serve as that slot's PTC (payload timeliness committee). If the whole PTC doesn't receive and vote on the payload by the 9 second mark the slot will go unfilled. In such case the builder,
who already paid out the bid to the proposer, will be left holding the bag without getting the execution order they paid for.

Under ePBS, builders are in a data delivery race that takes place over Ethereum's p2p gossip network. Optimum has already built an ultra fast p2p data delivery engine (mump2p). Naturally, we're preparing to offer our services to the builder market once Glamsterdam comes online, so they can consistently realize the economic value of having their bid selected.

items.new_information: 两步流程与注册出错不丢币、可回收机制

evidence.quote: Decouple Stake from Validator Registration

- Staking becomes a 2-step flow: (1) deposit ETH + withdrawal credentials + a versioned authorization commitment on the execution layer to get a StakeID immediately, then (2) register the validator on the consensus layer using that StakeID and proof data (e.g., BLS pubkey + proof of possession).

- Validator registration verification moves to the consensus layer, which can enforce rules that require global validator state (e.g., preventing reused credentials, ensuring a stake isn’t already bound, and reserving credentials during pending registration). Bad registration data no longer implies funds are lost; the stake can remain unregistered.

- Lifecycle operations (top-ups, withdrawals, and EIP-7251 consolidations) reference StakeID instead of validator pubkey; additionally, unregistered stakes can be fully recovered by the withdrawal authority via a CL-queued recovery mechanism (rate-limited per block and queue size-limited), but cannot be consolidated.
